mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as qspCname, c2.C_Name as qspSbCname, u1.U_Name as qspSbUname, dp.D_Name as qspSbDname, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Qs_Plan mn LEFT JOIN Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=mn.Qsp_Cid LEFT JOIN Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=mn.Qsp_Sb_Cid LEFT JOIN Sys_User u1 on u1.U_ID=mn.Qsp_Sb_Uid LEFT JOIN Sys_Department dp on dp.D_ID=mn.Qsp_Sb_Did left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Qsp_Id where mn.Qsp_Id=#{qspId}
